title: The Good Samaritan
summary: Love for our neighbor shows mercy in action. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Luke 10:25-37 and look for how this passage teaches: Love for our neighbor shows mercy in action.

tell_it: Jesus told about a Samaritan who helped a hurt man when others passed by. Mercy means stopping to help.
understand_it: Love for our neighbor shows mercy in action. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: The Good Samaritan reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Mercy matters.
age_8_11_explanation: The Good Samaritan shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Love for our neighbor shows mercy in action.
teen_explanation: The Good Samaritan gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that love for our neighbor shows mercy in action. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Love for our neighbor shows mercy in action.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when mercy is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Who helped the hurt man?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: The Samaritan. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that love for our neighbor shows mercy in action.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Luke 10:37 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in The Good Samaritan?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Mercy Road
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Love for our neighbor shows mercy in action.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from The Good Samaritan. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
